data.headline: Switch supplier to cut unit cost 10% and lower shipping risk
data.why: The alternative supplier reduces cost by 10% while keeping the same 5‑week lead time, and cuts the share of cost exposed to sea‑freight shocks from 60% to 30%. Simulation shows the plan beats the steady‑rival case by the figures above and eliminates the cash‑overrun risk.
data.watch_out: New supplier is untested; quality slips or hidden fees could erase the savings and delay deliveries.
data.recheck_when: After first 200 units delivered or if Cape routing delays exceed 14 days.
